title: 03 / Detect a fault and recover
capture: Actual Gazebo X11 window, continuous wall-time capture at 30 fps
overlay: Post-produced from live event timestamps; no motion retiming

stages.text: Robot executing | fresh joint-state feedback is arriving
INJECT: stop feedback delivery to the supervisor; physics continues
FAULT LATCHED | stale feedback detected; cancellation requested
New command rejected while fault is latched
Restore feedback | explicitly verify readiness and recover
Recovered | accept fresh intent, without replaying the old goal
PASS | fresh command reaches its measured target after recovery
